allocation_source: FBN Strategie de placement - Automne 2026, supplied strategie-placement-profil.pdf, page 1, visually verified ranges.
assumptions: All non-allocation thresholds, asset mapping and color precedence are team assumptions.
HHI is sum of squared whole-portfolio position weights, including one cash bucket; no ETF look-through.
HHI watch begins at 0.15; new/worsened concentration above 0.25 is red. HHI uses index points, not the allocation 5-percentage-point buffer.
Near-limit warnings apply to meaningful asset-class boundaries only (exclude 0% minima and 100% maxima).
Strict improvement is green only if no breach is created or worsened; unchanged existing breaches remain yellow for review.
Single-stock, crypto and explicit exclusion breaches are red when created or worsened.
Cash-funded long-only trades; fractional units; zero fees and slippage; no automatic sale of ZST.TO for funding.
Data ages: securities and FX at most 7 calendar days; crypto at most 2 days. Calendar-day returns use 365 for annualization.
Missing data never passes silently: a rule that cannot be evaluated returns an unresolved item. unresolved_handling decides per rule whether it is a yellow note or a manual review (default yellow).

Goal coverage: money needed by a date only counts if the asset, in its worst fall in the 5-year provided price window, recovered in less time than is left. Counted value = market value x (1 + that worst fall). Historical stress, not a forecast.
Goals are funded earliest first, each from the most liquid usable assets first (cash, then the shortest past recovery). A goal is flagged only when the money covering it and all earlier goals falls.
ESG: exclusions cover equity exposure (single stocks and equity-fund look-through from issuer fact sheets). Corporate bonds inside bond funds are not looked through.
Trades are only flagged by the goal and ESG rules when they create or worsen a problem; selling or improving is never flagged by them.

profiles.*.asset_class_ranges.rationale: Recommended asset-class ranges per profile, strategie-placement-profil.pdf page 1.

profiles.*.single_stock_max.rationale: Caps a single company so one issuer cannot dominate; tighter for cautious profiles.

profiles.*.crypto_max.rationale: No crypto for Income/Conservative/Balanced; small sleeve for growth profiles.

profiles.*.sector_max.rationale: Growth profile sector cap (look-through) to limit one-theme portfolios.

yellow_buffer.rationale: 5 percentage points from a range limit is close enough to warn before it is crossed.

hhi_watch.rationale: Concentration index level where a warning starts (about 7 equal positions).

hhi_max.rationale: Concentration index level treated as concentrated (about 4 equal positions).

goal_liquidity.planning_horizon_years.rationale: Goal installments within 5 years are checked; the longest recovered fall in the provided window took under 4 years.

goal_liquidity.red_within_months.rationale: An essential goal due within 2 years has little time to wait out a fall, so a coverage drop is red.

goal_liquidity.days_per_month.rationale: Average month length, same constant as the risk_metrics tool.

inflation_assumption.rationale: Bank of Canada 2% inflation-control target; only indexes goals marked indexed_to_inflation.

esg.default_max_lookthrough_excluded_sha.rationale: Funds rarely hold exactly 0% of a sector; 5% tolerates incidental exposure when a client sets no own limit.

unresolved_handling.rationale: A data gap is a yellow note so one gap does not block every trade; unreadable stored constraints need a person.

data_quality.rationale: Maximum price/FX staleness before a quote is unusable.
